business_summary.text: Finkurve Financial Services Limited is a technology-enabled, risk-first gold loan NBFC focused on disciplined growth and operational excellence, with a strategic focus on the South Indian market.

industry: Financial Services > Finance > Non Banking Financial Company (NBFC)

operating_notes.text: Co-lending partnership with Godrej has ₹21 Cr AUM, targeting 20% of total portfolio by FY27
Branch capex is ₹14-15 lakh per branch with opex of ₹2.5-3 lakh per branch
Average portfolio LTV is 72%, with stress testing for 15-20% gold price corrections
Average ticket size increased from ₹1.31L to ₹1.87L YoY
Average AUM per branch is ₹10.3 Cr; targeted at ₹12-13 Cr
New branches take 12-18 months to break even at ₹5-6 Cr AUM

timeline.summary: Finkurve Financial Services Limited held its Q4 & FY26 earnings call on May 21, 2026, reporting record AUM growth of 149% YoY to ₹1,096 Cr and PAT growth of 105% YoY to ₹6.98 Cr, while maintaining strong asset quality metrics.

Finkurve Financial Services Limited held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 13, 2026, reporting AUM growth of 135% YoY to ₹1,900 Cr and reaffirming FY27 guidance of 50-60% AUM growth with a co-lending target of 15-20%.
